transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?
I came in because the doctor at my insurance physical said my weight was too low. I mean, I just see myself as lean—I'm on ladders and working long days painting, so I figured that was why.
How do you feel about the idea of gaining weight?
I get pretty tense about it, honestly. If the scale goes up even a little—like after a client dinner or eating bread—I start cutting back the next day so it doesn’t stick.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I don’t have the exact numbers with me. The doctor at the insurance physical said my weight was too low, but I’ve always thought I just look lean from being on ladders and working long days painting.
If you have menstrual periods, have they become irregular or stopped altogether?
I’m male, so I don’t have menstrual periods.
Have you noticed any decrease in your sex drive or changes in your sexual functioning?
I haven’t really noticed any clear change there.
Have you recently had any significant weight loss?
I’m not sure I’ve had any big weight loss. The insurance doctor said my weight was too low, but I’ve always figured I’m just lean from climbing ladders and working long days painting.
Even though you see yourself as lean, do you ever feel that your body or certain parts of it are too fat?
Yeah, I guess I do. If I catch myself in a mirror, or see a photo of myself next to one of my murals, I end up judging the whole day by whether my stomach and face look sharp enough.
Do you deliberately avoid eating specific foods that you consider fattening?
Yeah. Most days I just have coffee, maybe a protein bar between paint jobs, then a small dinner. A full meal feels like it would slow me down.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating to keep from gaining weight?
No, I haven’t done that.
Do you ever take laxatives to help control or reduce your weight?
I’m not sure what you mean by that. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Do you engage in vigorous exercise or strenuous workouts specifically to burn off calories or keep your weight down?
I’m not really sure what counts as vigorous. My job keeps me moving around, but I don’t do workouts specifically for that.
Do you take any diet pills or appetite suppressants to help control your weight?
I don’t think so. I don’t take anything like that for my weight.
